name: Corporate Action General Information SD 62
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action general information.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

EventGroup.name: Event Group
EventGroup.definition: DTC processing domain/ category for event types.

EventType.name: Event Type
EventType.definition: DTCC (The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation) native corporate action event type name. Used in place for the events that cannot be classified by ISO code and mapped to OTHR or when two or more distinct events (in DTCC model) use same ISO code and there are no additional data elements that distinguish those two or more events.

SubEventType.name: Sub Event Type
SubEventType.definition: DTCC (The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation) native corporate action sub event type name further defines the event type.
